Their crowded centers and shared motion make them different from the loose groupings of young stars scattered through the galaxy. NGC 7006 is cataloged as a globular cluster by SIMBAD, which also places it at right ascension 21h 01m 29.465s and declination +16\u00b0 11\u2032 16.49\u2033 (J2000).
